# What should you charge for a newsletter sponsorship?

> Free newsletter sponsorship rate calculator. Enter your list size, open rate, and niche to get a price range for a dedicated send, primary placement, secondary placement, and classified ad — based on commonly cited newsletter-ad-market CPM benchmarks. No sign-up, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
